what_happened: The seed report (01_seed-audit-findings.md) pre-measured activation surface, grant counts, tagged-write dates, and context-scoping probe outcomes across all six loaded repositories before this research dispatch started, eliminating the need to re-run verify-sapience-mcp.sh and verify-sapience-context-scoping.sh per repo; this dispatch only needed to read source files and cross-reference open-task descriptions.

Task 637's own description frames a RESIDUAL_HOLDS result from verify-sapience-context-scoping.sh as something the task must eliminate, but that script's own header and context/project/sapience/domain/injection-site-scoping.md both document RESIDUAL_HOLDS as the EXPECTED, already-accepted green state today (the only remedy is an external vendor change, already drafted as an Owner Action message); there is no local code path that turns it into RESIDUAL_LIFTED.

Research report 02's recommendation 3 (append the capture-extraction-stall diagnosis item to task 636's GOAL section before 636 entered planning) was never executed; 636 was dispatched with its original five GOAL items and completed, leaving the capture-stall item unowned. This plan picks it up as Phase 3 instead. A recommendation that depends on mutating ANOTHER open task's description has no mechanical carrier in the plan/implement lifecycle -- nothing re-reads a prior round's research report at the next task's dispatch.

Planning-time measurement across all five healthy loaded repos showed goals 1 and 4 already mechanically satisfied by the completed dependency tasks: check (e) passes at exactly 7 grants everywhere, the postflight script plus both core call sites are deployed everywhere, and a 636-authored note was confirmed live in the vault with its [repo:nvim] tag. That shrank the plan from a re-implementation to a 4-phase verification-plus-one-new-check pass (4.75h).

Phase 1 baseline measurement found postflight-sapience-notes.sh deployed non-executable (-rw-r--r--) in all five repositories, tracked as git mode 100644 in the source store vs sapience-remember.sh's 100755. Both call sites invoke it via 'bash <path>' so this does not block the postflight write, but Phase 2's check (j) is specified to assert the executable bit as one of its four pass conditions, which would make check (j) FAIL everywhere today. Resolved by chmod +x on the source-store script in Phase 2 (plus the already-deployed copy in this repository) so the plan's own 'satisfies all four conditions today' claim holds.

Phase 1 cross-repo baseline found four of five loaded repositories (.dotfiles, BimodalLogic, sf1-engine, sapience-app) running a 348-line pre-task-636 deployed verify-sapience-mcp.sh lacking checks (h) and (i) entirely, versus this repository's current 500-line copy. This concretely confirms (for the verifier script itself, not just the write path) the exact 'deploy predates the mechanism' failure mode check (j) is meant to catch, and validates that Phase 4's five-repository redeploy is load-bearing rather than a formality.
